description: This file is a shell script containing test cases for a Git and Perforce integration, specifically testing the 'git p4 submit' command with various options and scenarios. It includes setup, test execution, and validation steps for features like shelved changes, description parsing, copy/rename detection, and more.

methods.name: make_job
methods.description: Creates a new Perforce job with a specified name, setting a standard description.

methods.name: last_shelve
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent shelved change number from Perforce.

methods.name: make_shelved_cl
methods.description: Creates and shelve a change with a specified description, returning the change number.
